_readme: Published status/valuation_range for every YC directory company that already appears in a landed investor's base.csv, matched on the loose name key plus YC's own former_names. COLLECTION.md invariant 10 BINDS these two columns: a YC row that disagrees fails verify, and the fix is to align the stale side (freshest as-of by default), not to accept it. So this is the starting answer for these rows, carried with its citation and its source investor, and the grind overrides it only on fresher cited evidence — which it then must write back to the other side at alignment. Rows flagged internally_disagrees already disagree BETWEEN landed investors and carry every reading under `all`; those are pre-existing invariant-10 breaks this run surfaces rather than creates.
